name: Abomination of Llanowar
description: An undead monstrosity formed when a scout troop of elves was fused together by the necromantic morass.

description_citations.text: "Llanowar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Llanowar scout troop discovers the necromantic morass; a curious recruit touches it and it fuses the elves into an undead monstrosity.
timeline.quote: A curious recruit touched the dark tangle, and it imploded, sucking the elves in and fusing them into an undead monstrosity.

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "The necromantic morass". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A second scout troop is pulled alive into the monstrosity; one elf escapes and that part of the forest is declared forbidden.
timeline.quote: A single elf escaped, and that part of the forest was declared forbidden.

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "The necromantic morass". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
